name: Clipboard Shelf
description:
Clipboard Shelf turns CORSAIR XENEON Edge into a touch-first shelf for recent Windows text clipboard history. Copy text anywhere in Windows and recent entries appear as readable cards with a clear current-copy indicator. Tap a card once to make it the active clipboard value again.

Pin snippets you never want normal history pruning to remove, mark favorites for quick filtering, recognize URLs at a glance, search on roomier XENEON layouts, delete individual entries, or clear the full history with a confirmation step. Long and multiline text stay readable, while very large entries keep their full local copy data and send only a bounded preview to the display.

Private Mode pauses new capture and hides existing clipboard text on the XENEON display until you resume. If Windows switches to an image, file, or other non-text clipboard item, the CURRENT marker clears instead of showing stale state.

Reliable continuous Windows clipboard history requires the free PackRat Clipboard Shelf Bridge for Windows. Run it once and it installs for the current Windows user and starts with Windows. Copy its locally generated pairing code from the tray icon into Clipboard Shelf settings in iCUE. Clipboard history is not exposed until that pairing succeeds.

The bridge listens only on loopback, stores clipboard state and its pairing code locally with Windows DPAPI protection, and never sends clipboard contents to PackRat servers, cloud sync, analytics, or CI logs.

Version 1 is intentionally text-first. Files and images are not included because reliable text history is more useful than a fragile oversized feature set.

Part of the PackRat Ecosystem.
release_notes:
• Readable recent Windows text clipboard cards with one-tap copy
• Pins, favorites, URL recognition, filters, and long-text handling
• Secure per-user bridge pairing, automatic reconnect, and Windows startup
• Configurable local history with individual delete and confirmed clear-all
• Private Mode pauses capture and hides clipboard text on the display
• Eight tuned XENEON Edge layouts with accurate CURRENT state
